### Known gaps

- SettingEntry.DataType/Type unpopulated: the SDK gives only example values, no per-setting-name table to derive them from.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- Server-set status/version metadata has no source: DirectoryDescription.OsVersion default/StageReason, DomainController.StatusReason, IpRouteInfo.IpRouteStatusReason, SchemaExtensionInfo.SchemaExtensionStatusReason, Assessment.StatusCode/StatusReason/Version, SettingEntry.RequestStatusMessage. AWS assigns these internally with no documented value set; this backend reaches no failure states.
- TrustState VerifyFailed/UpdateFailed/Failed and SnapshotStatus Failed need real external-domain connectivity or storage faults that an in-memory backend cannot produce.

### Deferred

- Settings DataType/Type static lookup table (see gaps): would need to be built and verified against AWS's own Directory Service setting-name documentation, not guessed.
